date.source: The show's own script, posted 17 July 1995 and billed in the text as 'our first ever Monday Night Mayhem telecast.'

evidence.source: The federation's own show script, subject 'MCMW MONDAY NIGHT MAYHEM' (17 July 1995)
evidence.note: Full announcer-narrated script, the sole and primary source for every match and angle on this record.

matches.note: Brian Boulder pinned Evan Rice with a Rockslide Powerslam.

Billed as a win for the team "the Lords of the Jungle"; King of the Beasts pinned Alberto Kane with a big splash off the ropes. Bearilla speaks alongside King of the Beasts and manager Khan in the post-match interview, per the team's own roster listing elsewhere in this wing's held documents.
The Hitchiker won by DQ after Ludvig Von Frankensteiner (not minted; no billed match appearance of his own on this card) ran in and attacked him. The Hitchiker vowed revenge.

The Nightmare Warrior clotheslined Jordie Ashe repeatedly until Ashe left the ring and was counted out. A post-match brawl drew in Hans Helmet and Brian Boulder (neither minted for this card), opening a feud between Boulder and the Warrior.

A restarted match after a double countout; The Rebel rolled up The Great Kamikaze with a small package for the pin after Kamikaze missed a second moonsault attempt from the top of the production table.
